Hi all,

The main finding is that 4–6% of units show a fault in early testing after assembly. Running additional module tests before assembly should address this.

Customer churn in the Nordic region is up, mostly among small accounts. The sales team thinks this is driven by the recent price change rather than the product.

We will pause the Nordtak supplier contract instead of cancelling it, because switching suppliers mid-year would delay the Q2 production ramp by about two months.

Anna Jónsdóttir will take over the Reykjavík office, but only after the current lead finishes the ISO certification audit.

Thanks
